title: Mouse Without Borders: Left-click does not work on pop-ups and taskbar context menus
author: walkmen78

judgment.rationale: The translated report describes left-click failure on remote popups and taskbar context menus, but the only confirmations are from 0.81.1 and 0.84.1 and there is no current configuration, privilege boundary, or diagnostic report.
evidence: The report covers system/application dialogs and taskbar context menus on the remote computer.
A screenshot of numerous errors was posted without structured diagnostic context.
A second user confirmed the issue on 0.84.1.
No newer PowerToys confirmation is present.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a current stable retest with both PCs' versions, service/elevation state, and a fresh report from the controlled PC.

fix_assessment.rationale: The evidence is too old and lacks the privilege/input boundary needed for a Mouse Without Borders fix assessment.

issue_context.summary: Mouse Without Borders remote left-click reportedly fails on popups and taskbar context menus.
known_information: The symptom occurs on the remote computer.
Normal window clicks are not clearly characterized.
The issue was still present on 0.84.1.
inferences: Elevation or protected UI boundaries may be relevant, but the report does not establish them.
issue_context.analysis: Current environment and privilege details are required before treating this as the same bug as newer edge-switching reports.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the current public issue body, labels, assignees, and up to the latest 20 public comments returned by GitHub.
Kept the existing dashboard read-only; no dashboard files were modified or published.

information_gaps.information: Current versions and privilege/service configuration on both PCs.
information_gaps.why_needed: Mouse input behavior changes across integrity levels.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: List PowerToys/Windows versions, elevation, and whether MWB runs as a service.

information_gaps.information: A current diagnostic report from the controlled PC.
information_gaps.why_needed: The remote-side failure needs local logs.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Submit /bugreport immediately after a failed click.

actions.label: Request current MWB click-failure evidence
actions.note: Draft candidate only; no comment or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body: Could someone still affected retest on the current stable PowerToys release and provide both PCs' Windows/PowerToys versions, whether PowerToys is elevated, and whether Mouse Without Borders is installed as a service? Please distinguish normal windows from elevated/system dialogs and taskbar context menus, then submit `/bugreport` from the controlled PC immediately after a failed click.
